scope: Host Unix raw-v2 listener positive descriptor ownership and duplication-error cleanup. Focused Rust runtime tests on macOS; no ordinary CLI, automatic standard-library bake, native/AOT, other-host execution, full VBC pass or registry-service verdict.
production_behavior: A listener owning fd0 stays owned through try_clone. A successful duplicate is transferred as its actual positive OS descriptor, with the original closed. A failed duplicate closes the input owner and returns its actual negative OS error. Registered listener normalization uses the same helper; non-Unix behavior and socket I/O are unchanged.
fixture_authority: Each fd0 test starts a fresh exact-test child and requires exit41 after assertions and cleanup. Only the child closes stdin or lowers its descriptor limit. The exhaustion child owns fd3, then lowers soft RLIMIT_NOFILE to4: bind can own0, and a duplicate with minimum3 fails EMFILE. No parent standard descriptor/limit changes or connect/read/accept traffic.
